# Dataset 2026.3: build report

Generated by `pnpm --filter @empire/data generate` from the files in `packages/data/config/`. Every judgment call below comes from those files; edit them and rebuild to change it.

## Summary

- **188 territories**: 173 countries, 9 territories, 6 regions.
- **315 land borders** and **101 sea lanes** (69 automatic, 32 manual).
- **Map**: `map.topo.json` is 331 KB with 31,609 points (from 75,133), 1,459 rings. Visvalingam weight ≥ 0.25 px² on a 2400 px Natural Earth world map; islands ≥ 20 km² and every member's main island kept (1 sliver ring(s) kept whole); quantization 1e+5.
- **Shapes**: Natural Earth 1:50m Admin 0 – Countries (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_50m_admin_0_countries.geojson), sha256 `3e458fc036ad0a66…`.
- **Statistics**: World Bank WDI, most recent non-empty value per indicator (API last updated 2026-07-13), plus the estimates listed below.
- **Hand edits** (review these first): 9 merges, 6 regions, 10 splits, 14 dropped features; 32 manual sea lanes and 10 removed automatic ones; 2 value overrides; 15 World Bank figures replaced.

## Validation

- `validateGraph`: no problems.
- Map geometry: 188 geometries, ids identical to the dataset, every one with area > 0 and wound so that d3.geoArea < 2π. Winding fixes: none needed.
- Well-known land borders: FRA–ESP ✓, USA–CAN ✓, USA–MEX ✓, RUS–CHN ✓, IND–CHN ✓, BRA–ARG ✓, EGY–ISR ✓, ZAF–LSO ✓, ITA–CHE ✓, DEU–POL ✓, IRL–GBR ✓, THA–MYS ✓, PNG–IDN ✓, IND–PAK ✓, FRA–DEU ✓, RUS–UKR ✓, GUF–BRA ✓, HTI–DOM ✓, MAR–ESH ✓, SRB–XKX ✓, ISR–PSE ✓, KOR–PRK ✓.
- Expected sea lanes: GBR–FRA ✓, ESP–MAR ✓, USA–RUS ✓, JPN–KOR ✓, AUS–PNG ✓, LKA–IND ✓, DNK–SWE ✓, ISL–GRL ✓, NZL–AUS ✓, TWN–CHN ✓, ITA–TUN ✓, YEM–DJI ✓, SAU–EGY ✓, IRN–OMN ✓, SGP–IDN ✓, CUB–USA ✓, TTO–VEN ✓, FIN–EST ✓, MDG–MOZ ✓, CAN–GRL ✓.

## Map canon

Boundaries follow Natural Earth's de facto drawing (for example Crimea inside Russia, Kashmir along the lines of control), except where a split below moves polygons between territories. Every one of the 242 Natural Earth features is accounted for; the build fails if one is not: 181 kept, 13 merged, 34 bundled, 14 dropped.

## Sea lanes

Automatic lanes join territories that are not land neighbors when their coastlines (arcs used by exactly one territory) come within **200 km**, unless every connecting segment crosses a third territory's land. Manual lanes come from `config/sea-lanes.yaml` and use the closest coastline points (or the coastline nearest a hand-given point) with no distance limit. From/To are the drawn endpoints.

## Game values

Score = weighted mean of min–max normalized log10 metrics (weights: gdpNominalUsd 0.3, gdpPppUsd 0.2, population 0.3, areaKm2 0.2); a missing metric drops out and the remaining weights are renormalized. Values are assigned by rank against the target distribution, then `overrides` in `config/values.yaml` are applied.

```
20 │ ██                                         2  (target 2)
19 │                                            0  (target 0)
18 │ █                                          1  (target 1)
17 │ █                                          1  (target 1)
16 │ ██                                         2  (target 2)
15 │ ███                                        3  (target 2)
14 │ █                                          1  (target 2)
13 │ ███                                        3  (target 3)
12 │ ███                                        3  (target 3)
11 │ ████                                       4  (target 4)
10 │ █████                                      5  (target 5)
 9 │ ██████                                     6  (target 6)
 8 │ ████████                                   8  (target 8)
```

### Replacements, adjustments and notes

- ARE areaKm2: replaced World Bank 98.6k (2023) with 83.6k — the World Bank's 98,648 km² includes coastal waters
- CAN areaKm2: replaced World Bank 15.63M (2023) with 9.98M — the World Bank reports 15.6 million km², far above Canada's land and inland water
- FRO areaKm2: replaced World Bank 13.0k (2023) with 1.4k — the World Bank series jumps from 1,396 km² (2019) to 12,960 km² (2020 on), far above the land area
- DOM areaKm2: replaced World Bank 146.8k (2023) with 48.7k — the World Bank reports 146,840 km², three times the island's Dominican part
- FRA areaKm2: replaced World Bank 606.4k (2023) with 549.1k — the World Bank series changed in 2020 to 606,410 km², which is neither metropolitan France (549,087 km² until 2019) nor France with its overseas departments
- GRL areaKm2: replaced World Bank 410.4k (2023) with 2.17M — the World Bank reports only the ice-free area (410,450 km²)
- HRV areaKm2: replaced World Bank 88.1k (2023) with 56.6k — the World Bank's 88,070 km² includes the territorial sea
- NOR areaKm2: replaced World Bank 624.5k (2023) with 386.2k — the World Bank reports 624,500 km², far above Norway's land and inland water
- SRB areaKm2: replaced World Bank 85.0k (2023) with 77.5k — the map shows Serbia without Kosovo; the World Bank's 84,990 km² matches neither Serbia with Kosovo nor without it
- SSD gdpNominalUsd: replaced World Bank 12.00B (2015) with 5.73B — the World Bank's latest figure is from 2015 ($12.0B), before the currency collapse
- SSD gdpPppUsd: replaced World Bank 12.83B (2015) with 17.88B — the World Bank's latest figure is from 2015
- SWE areaKm2: replaced World Bank 528.7k (2023) with 450.3k — the World Bank's 528,660 km² includes coastal waters
- VEN gdpPppUsd: replaced World Bank 621.14B (2011) with 237.68B — the World Bank's latest figure is from 2011 ($621B), before the economic collapse
- YEM gdpNominalUsd: replaced World Bank 21.61B (2018) with 7.90B — the World Bank's latest figure is from 2018 ($21.6B), during the war's early years
- YEM gdpPppUsd: replaced World Bank 92.76B (2013) with 29.91B — the World Bank's latest figure is from 2013 ($92.8B), before the war
- FRA population: 68.72M minus 2.30M for GUF, GLP, MTQ, REU, MYT, because the World Bank's France figures include the overseas departments, which play separately here
- FRA gdpNominalUsd: 3366.32B minus 60.45B for GUF, GLP, MTQ, REU, MYT, because the World Bank's France figures include the overseas departments, which play separately here
- FRA gdpPppUsd: 4396.41B minus 78.94B for GUF, GLP, MTQ, REU, MYT, because the World Bank's France figures include the overseas departments, which play separately here
